fnol_text: My name is Dana Al-Sayed and I live at 929 Kestrel Court, Greenville, SC 29637. You can reach me on (555) 711-1779 or dana.alsayed@example.com. I was stopped at lights on 3 December 2025 when the car behind, driven by Kofi Laurent, went into the back of mine. Rear bumper and boot are badly damaged. Policy MT-2025-00109. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Al-Sayed on (555) 711-1779 to acknowledge the claim. Dana confirmed the loss date as 3 December 2025.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Chloe O'Connell gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Kofi Laurent reports a mild concussion and attended Riverside Medical Center. Dana reports minor burns to the hand.
